description: Header file defining the BitTube class, which manages file descriptors for inter-process communication, including methods for sending and receiving objects, parceling, and managing file descriptors within the Android GUI subsystem.

classes.name: BitTube
classes.description: A class for managing a pair of file descriptors for sending and receiving data, with parcelable capabilities and object transfer methods.

methods.description: Default constructor for an uninitialized BitTube.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes BitTube with a specified buffer size.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes BitTube with a default buffer size.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes BitTube from a Parcel.
